title: Argos Void
author: Certain-Win3425
selftext:
I develop my own classical Browsergame.

25 years ago I fell in love with **Tribal Wars**, and I've been playing **Diablo 2** since '99. So I decided to build something in between — in a brand-new setting. That's how **Argos Void** was born.

Build your own planets and fight other alliances and players with your own fleet of spaceships. Every ship can be **equipped** to make it stronger — **loot** weapons and shields with random stats from **pirates** or other players. Trading is a big focus too: items from **common to unique**, plus other tradeable goods.

The galaxy has **4 zones**, each with its own hostile environment, so you need a dedicated **shield for each zone** to explore it. Play on a **permanent world**, or compete in time-limited **season worlds**.

Alpha Season ist complete free to play, I'm looking forward for your feedback
